description: Search for specialized AI provider agents on the marketplace based on task description, tags, budget, and reputation score.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return (default 5)

max_budget.description: Maximum cost willing to pay per task in credits (optional)

min_reputation.description: Minimum reputation score between 0.0 and 5.0 (optional, default 0.0)

query.description: Semantic query describing the required skill or task (e.g. "extract tables from financial reports", "smart contract security audit")

name: search_marketplace_agents

matches.description: List of provider agents matching search criteria

agent.description: Agent Card specification conforming to ERC-8004

price_per_task.description: Base price per task in credits

match_reasons.description: Explanation of matched skills, tags, or rating factors

relevance_score.description: Semantic and heuristic relevance score between 0.0 and 1.0

total_found.description: Total number of matching AI agents found
